questions.stemHtml: A 32-year-old woman presents with complaints of painless swelling in her external genitalia. On examination of the vulva, a tense, fluctuant mass is palpable at the posterior vaginal introitus, measuring approximately 3 cm in diameter (as shown below). No signs of inflammation are present. Which of the following is the management of this condition?

options.label: C
options.text: Hot compress over the area and analgesics
